# Fig 4B

```{r fig4a, }

clinical_vs_MV = read.table("scaledRegressionCoefficients.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)

# ROTATED - Anguraj
clinical_vs_MV_forplot = -1*(clinical_vs_MV)
clinical_vs_MV_forplot[abs(clinical_vs_MV_forplot)<1.96] = 0

pdf("4B_iPhenMap_heatmap_pov_clinical_multiomics.pdf")
p_mv_vs_clinical = Heatmap(
  clinical_vs_MV_forplot,name="Effect",
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,rect_gp = gpar(col= "black",lwd=1.5),
  row_names_side = "left", row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 17),
  show_row_dend = TRUE,  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-3, -1.96, -1.95, 1.95, 1.96, 3), c("#446455", "#A4C4A5", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#FDF2D2", "#FDD262")),
  heatmap_legend_param=list(color_bar = "continuous",at=seq(-3,3, by=1))
)
p_mv_vs_clinical

activated_mvs_df = rbind(c(1,0,0,1,0,0), c(1,0,0,0,0,0), c(0,1,1,0,1,1), c(0,0,0,1,0,0))
colnames(activated_mvs_df) = c("MV1", "MV2", "MV3", "MV4", "MV5", "MV6")
rownames(activated_mvs_df) = c("RNA", "Protein", "Metabolites", "CNA")

p_activated_mvs = Heatmap(
  activated_mvs_df,name="Effect",
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,rect_gp = gpar(col= "black",lwd=1.5),
  row_names_side = "left", row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 17),
  show_row_dend = TRUE,  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("#FFFFFF", "#446455"))
)
p_activated_mvs

mv_pov = read.table("PoV.txt")

ggplot(mv_pov, aes(x=MV, y=PoV, col=Type, group=Type))+
  geom_line(lwd=1.5)+
  geom_point(size=3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=colour_wes_darjeeling1_n5)+
  theme_bw()

dev.off()

```

# Fig 4C

```{r fig4b, fig.dim=c(9,5)}

pdf("4C_iPhenMap_multiomics_features_loadings.pdf")
loadings = read.table("scaledLoadingsCoefficients.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)

# ROTATED - Anguraj
loadings_mv1 = bind_cols(rownames(loadings), (-1)*(loadings[,1]))
names(loadings_mv1) = c("Feature", "Loading")
loadings_mv1 = loadings_mv1[!is.na(loadings_mv1$Loading),]
loadings_mv1$Feature = factor(loadings_mv1$Feature, levels = loadings_mv1$Feature)
loadings_mv1$Feature_type = ifelse (grepl("_", loadings_mv1$Feature), "Protein", "RNA")

p_protein = ggplot(loadings_mv1[loadings_mv1$Feature_type=="Protein",], aes(x=Feature, y=Loading, col = Loading>0, label=Feature))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", show.legend = F)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(position = "identity", max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = F)+
  facet_grid(~Feature_type, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")+
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Cavalcanti1"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-15,5))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
p_rna = ggplot(loadings_mv1[loadings_mv1$Feature_type=="RNA",], aes(x=Feature, y=Loading, col = Loading>0, label=Feature))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", show.legend = F)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(position = "identity", max.overlaps = 10, show.legend = F)+
  facet_grid(~Feature_type, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")+
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Cavalcanti1"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-15,5))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

grid.arrange(p_rna, p_protein, widths=c(576,230))

dev.off()
```


# Fig 4D

```{r fig4c }

# reading scaled loadings
mv_loadings <- read.delim("scaledLoadingsCoefficients.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dim(mv_loadings)

# remove those loadings with NA for MV1
na_mv1 <- which(!is.na(mv_loadings$MV1))
length(na_mv1)

# Consider MV1 loadings <=-3 and >=3
mv1_pos <- which(mv_loadings$MV1[na_mv1] >= 2)
mv1_neg <- which(mv_loadings$MV1[na_mv1] <= -2)
length(mv1_pos)
length(mv1_neg)

mv1 <- c(mv1_pos,mv1_neg)
length(mv1)

mv_loadings_mv1 <- mv_loadings$MV1[mv1]
names(mv_loadings_mv1) <- rownames(mv_loadings)[mv1]
length(mv_loadings_mv1)

#parse the protein names - MV1 contains both genes and proteins
w_protein <- which(grepl("_",names(mv_loadings_mv1)) == TRUE)
length(w_protein)

protein <- NULL
for(i in 1:length(w_protein)){
protein[i] <- unlist(strsplit(names(mv_loadings_mv1[w_protein[i]]),"_"))[2]
}

w_protein_NA <- which(protein == "")

for(i in 1:length(w_protein_NA)){
protein[w_protein_NA[i]] <- unlist(strsplit(rownames(mv_loadings)[mv1[w_protein[w_protein_NA[i]]]],"_"))[4]
}

names(mv_loadings_mv1)[w_protein] <- protein

#selecting only positive MV1
mv_loadings_mv1_pos <- mv_loadings_mv1[which(mv_loadings_mv1>0)]
length(mv_loadings_mv1_pos)

#selecting only negative MV1
mv_loadings_mv1_neg <- mv_loadings_mv1[which(mv_loadings_mv1<0)]
length(mv_loadings_mv1_neg)

#hypeR parameter settings

library(qusage)

library(hypeR)

# HyperR database
#H <-msigdb_download("Homo sapiens", "H", "")
BIOCARTA <- msigdb_download("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:BIOCARTA")
KEGG <- msigdb_download("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:KEGG_LEGACY")
REACTOME <- msigdb_download("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:REACTOME")

#combined these databases
HBKR <- c(BIOCARTA,KEGG, REACTOME)


#hypeR analysis for MV1 positive features
hyp_HBKR_pos <- hypeR(unique(names(mv_loadings_mv1_pos)), HBKR, test="hypergeometric")
hyp_show(hyp_HBKR_pos)
#pdf("20240723_COLOSSUS_MV1_pos_genes_HBKR_hyperR.pdf")
hyp_dots(hyp_HBKR_pos, fdr = 0.2, top = 20)
#dev.off()
hyp_emap(hyp_HBKR_pos, top=100, val="fdr", fdr = 0.2)

#hypeR analysis for MV1 negative features
hyp_HBKR_neg <- hypeR(names(mv_loadings_mv1_neg), HBKR, test="hypergeometric")
hyp_show(hyp_HBKR_neg )
#pdf("20240723_COLOSSUS_MV1_neg_genes_HBKR_hyperR.pdf")
hyp_dots(hyp_HBKR_neg , fdr = 0.2, top = 15)
#dev.off()
hyp_emap(hyp_HBKR_neg , top=100, val="fdr", fdr = 0.2)

```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## MV1 Loading Feature Extraction & hypeR Pathway Enrichment
## COLOSSUS | iPhenMap | VHIO Validation Cohort
## Sadanandam Lab, ICR
## ============================================================

library(hypeR)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# ── 1. Read scaled loadings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

loadings_path <- file.path(
  "Anguraj",
  "Retrospective_data/integrative_analysis/VHIO_only/validation",
  "test_to_1M_QC/VST/sd1/iPhenMAPresults/MetaGenes",
  "scaledLoadingsCoefficients.txt"
)

mv_loadings <- read.table(
  loadings_path,
  header = TRUE,
  sep    = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ── 2. Inspect dimensions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("Dimensions of mv_loadings:", dim(mv_loadings), "\n")
cat("Column names:", paste(colnames(mv_loadings), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("First few rows:\n")
print(head(mv_loadings))

# ── 3. Keep rows with non-NA MV1 values ───────────────────────────────────────

mv_loadings <- mv_loadings[!is.na(mv_loadings$MV1), , drop = FALSE]
cat("\nRows retained after NA removal:", nrow(mv_loadings), "\n")

# ── 4. Rotate MV1 (flip sign) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

mv_loadings$MV1 <- mv_loadings$MV1 * -1
cat("MV1 loadings sign-flipped (rotated by 180°).\n")

# ── 5. Apply MV1 loading cutoff ───────────────────────────────────────────────

mv1_pos_idx <- which(mv_loadings$MV1 >= 2)
mv1_neg_idx <- which(mv_loadings$MV1 <= -2)

cat("MV1 positive features (>= 2):", length(mv1_pos_idx), "\n")
cat("MV1 negative features (<= -2):", length(mv1_neg_idx), "\n")

# ── 6. Combine selected MV1 features ──────────────────────────────────────────

selected_idx     <- c(mv1_pos_idx, mv1_neg_idx)
selected_loadings <- mv_loadings[selected_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# ── 7. Extract MV1 values and feature names ────────────────────────────────────

mv1_values    <- selected_loadings$MV1
feature_names <- rownames(selected_loadings)

cat("\nSelected feature names (first 10):\n")
print(head(feature_names, 10))

# ── 8. Identify and parse protein-like entries (contain "_") ──────────────────

is_protein <- grepl("_", feature_names)
cat("\nProtein-like entries:", sum(is_protein), "| Gene-like entries:", sum(!is_protein), "\n")

parse_protein_name <- function(feat) {
  # Format: <UNIPROT_ID>_<GENE_SYMBOL>  e.g. P13284_IFI30
  # Gene symbol is always the LAST field after splitting on "_"
  parts <- strsplit(feat, "_")[[1]]
  candidate <- parts[length(parts)]
  
  # Safety fallback: if last field is empty or NA, return the full feature name
  if (is.na(candidate) || candidate == "") candidate <- feat
  
  return(candidate)
}

parsed_names <- feature_names
parsed_names[is_protein] <- sapply(feature_names[is_protein], parse_protein_name)

# Safety check: if any parsed name is still "", keep original feature name
empty_idx <- which(parsed_names == "" | is.na(parsed_names))
if (length(empty_idx) > 0) {
  cat("Recovering", length(empty_idx), "empty parsed names — reverting to original feature name.\n")
  parsed_names[empty_idx] <- feature_names[empty_idx]
}

cat("\nParsed feature names (first 10):\n")
print(head(parsed_names, 10))

# ── 9. Split into MV1 positive and negative feature sets ──────────────────────

# Re-index relative to selected_loadings (rows 1:length(mv1_pos_idx) are positive)
n_pos <- length(mv1_pos_idx)
n_neg <- length(mv1_neg_idx)

mv1_pos_names <- unique(parsed_names[seq_len(n_pos)])
mv1_neg_names <- unique(parsed_names[(n_pos + 1):(n_pos + n_neg)])

cat("\nUnique MV1 positive feature names:", length(mv1_pos_names), "\n")
cat("Unique MV1 negative feature names:", length(mv1_neg_names), "\n")

# ── 10. Load pathway gene set collections ─────────────────────────────────────

cat("\nLoading pathway gene sets from MSigDB...\n")

biocarta  <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:BIOCARTA")
kegg      <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY")
reactome  <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")

# Convert to named list of gene sets
make_genesets <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(gs_name) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop") %>%
    { setNames(.$genes, .$gs_name) }
}

HBKR <- c(
  make_genesets(biocarta),
  make_genesets(kegg),
  make_genesets(reactome)
)

cat("Total pathways in HBKR:", length(HBKR), "\n")

# ── 11. Run hypeR enrichment ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\nRunning hypeR on MV1 POSITIVE features...\n")
hyp_pos <- hypeR(
  signature = mv1_pos_names,
  genesets  = HBKR,
  test      = "hypergeometric",
  #background = 20000,     # approximate human proteome/genome background
 # pval      = 1,
 # fdr       = 0.2,
 # quiet     = FALSE
)

cat("\nRunning hypeR on MV1 NEGATIVE features...\n")
hyp_neg <- hypeR(
  signature = mv1_neg_names,
  genesets  = HBKR,
  test      = "hypergeometric",
 # background = 20000,
 #  pval      = 1,
 #  fdr       = 0.2,
 # quiet     = FALSE
)

# ── 12. View enrichment tables ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n=== MV1 POSITIVE enrichment table ===\n")
hyp_show(hyp_pos)

cat("\n=== MV1 NEGATIVE enrichment table ===\n")
hyp_show(hyp_neg)

# ── 13. Dot plots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\nGenerating dot plots...\n")

p_dot_pos <- hyp_dots(hyp_pos, fdr = 0.2, top = 15, title = "MV1 Positive — Top 20 Pathways")
p_dot_neg <- hyp_dots(hyp_neg, fdr = 0.2, top = 20, title = "MV1 Negative — Top 15 Pathways")

print(p_dot_pos)
print(p_dot_neg)

# Save plots as PDF
pdf("4D_hypeR_MV1_positive_dotplot.pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
print(p_dot_pos)
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "S10I_hypeR_MV1_negative_dotplot.pdf"), width = 9, height = 7)
print(p_dot_neg)
dev.off()


cat("\n✓ All outputs saved to:", out_dir, "\n")

# ── 16. Session info ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sessionInfo()
```
